affected_boundaries: native hook authentication to CLI reporting

observed_behavior: The native bound GWEN coordinator's three sanitized reports failed with CAMPAIGN_COORDINATOR_REQUIRED while coordinate and observe succeeded.
expected_behavior: The native coordinator can record its existing assignment's blocker through authenticated host tooling; unrelated sessions and workers remain denied.
causal_mechanism: The hook command matcher omitted the new reporting operation, and its writer required a standalone session environment variable which native commands do not receive. Native hook and CLI environments are separate: PLUGIN_DATA exists in the hook, but the actual command exposes CODEX_SESSION_ID. Earlier tests populated the standalone variable or shared the hook environment with the command, bypassing the failing boundary.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A new host-integrated operation uses a different identity representation than the owning adapter, while tests establish that identity directly below the adapter boundary.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The canonical host invocation cannot satisfy the writer's identity prerequisite even though the coordinator already has a valid scoped binding. Missing hook routing also omits other-session rejection.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Native coordinator mutations traverse the trusted hook, and command-side native session identity matches the bound ledger coordinator; standalone invocations use their explicit identity contract.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Recognize report-blocker in the existing campaign hook and compare command-side CODEX_SESSION_ID with the ledger coordinator. Prove hook-to-CLI reporting with separate environments, without PLUGIN_DATA or PONYTAIL_SESSION_ID in the command, and deny unrelated sessions and workers.

applicability_conditions: The native adapter owns a scoped coordinator binding.
A new mutation is routed separately from the trusted host command matcher.
known_non_matches: Standalone reporting with explicit matching identity passed.
Existing coordinate and observe commands succeeded in the same native coordinator.
confirmation_evidence: Live coordinator refresh preserved exact coordinator identity but reporting still failed.
The initial hook regression failed because the hook returned no authentication output.
Presence-only ordinary and elevated probes verified native session identity is available but hook storage variables are absent.
The separated-environment hook-to-CLI regression reproduced CAMPAIGN_COORDINATOR_REQUIRED before correcting command-side identity.
regression_proofs: tests/plan-input-hooks.test.js: blocker reporting authenticates the native coordinator across separate hook and command environments
tests/plan-input-hooks.test.js: worker attach is one-time, status re-roots, and worker mutations fail closed
